name: Rabbit
siboNotes: Excellent lean protein option for SIBO diets as it's naturally FODMAP-free and easy to digest.
preparationTips: Marinate in low-FODMAP herbs like rosemary or thyme to enhance flavor
Cook low and slow to prevent tough texture - braising or slow roasting works well
Season with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Pair with low-FODMAP root vegetables for a complete meal
nutritionalHighlights: Very lean with minimal saturated fat
Rich in B vitamins, especially B12
Good source of selenium and phosphorus
